Video Maker With Effects Free — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: Easily apply AI-powered effects (transitions, filters, music) to your videos and export finished edits in seconds.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB for cloud-based editing.
- No registration required: Get a free session token for 100 credits (valid 7 days) on first use.
- Intuitive prompts: Just describe how you want to edit, then download the polished result (ideal for TikTok and social media).
- Direct export, credits, upload, and session management workflows all included.
